evidence.decision: Chooses categories from essential/incidental sound and coexistence, separating resumable interruptions from replacement playback and route-loss privacy.
evidence.artifact: Delivers category/route/external-control/interruption-resume contract tied to the actual session implementation or review.
evidence.transformation: Meditation example removes global volume overrides, pauses on headphone loss and stops automatic resume over a newly chosen playlist.
evidence.verification: Checks silent mode, competing audio, route loss, temporary interruption and microphone privacy; unintended speakers or unauthorized resume fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies TV interaction-only sounds, Watch playback, visionOS attention/Now Playing rules and the closed-folio VoIP issue; hardware routing remains unverified without tests.
evidence.handoffs: Multitasking, Playing video and Feedback load for actual lifecycle, audiovisual or incidental-cue concerns.
evidence.distinctiveness: Audio category semantics, output ownership and interruption causes cannot be reduced to a generic media control checklist.
